text:
Gabe M: quick heads-up  new hire Marisol (remote, AZ) starts Mon. Checkr returned a "name variation" and vendor asked for a second ID. She only has a Mexican passport and an Arizona paper utility bill (comes in her maiden name).
Sofia L: thanks gabe. two tracks: 1) I-9: passport is List A and sufficient as long as it's original and unexpired. 2) BG vendor wants matching name on proof of address. ask candidate for a bank statement or official mail showing current name, or provide an affidavit.
Trent R: i can be authorized rep Mon 9am if she prefers in-person at our phoenix partner site. otherwise notary is fine and we reimburse up to $50. avoid using recruiting agency staff as rep.
Gabe M: marisol prefers notary. also mentioned she needs ADA accommodation on day 1 for a long intro session (hearing captions). Is there a standard flow?
Elaine H: HR note: we can arrange live captions on Zoom and record transcript. add "Accessibility: captions" to the invite and loop in DEI. Also confirm any ergonomic needs for shipped laptop.
Sofia L: on the Checkr side, vendor is slow today (holiday in their region). created ticket #CHK-8301. if they request additional docs we'll ask for bank statement; otherwise we can mark as under review and proceed with rep/notary for I-9.
OnboardBot: Onboarding checklist link: https://redwood-internal/people-ops/onboarding. Required: I-9, W-4, DD, emergency contact, benefits election. Auto-reminder set 48h pre-start.
Trent R: logistics: if notary route, candidate should sign Section 1, give original passport to notary who fills Section 2 using our Authorized Rep template. notary must print commission number. upload signed Section 2 + rep form to /secure/hr/onboarding within 24h.
ITShipBot: IT shipping note: if laptop ships mark "Hold for ID verification" and include encrypted 2fa token in sealed envelope. Ticket IT-7790 created.
Gabe M: payroll asked candidate to finish W-4 + direct deposit before payroll cutoff (Fri EOD). i sent a short DM with links and deadline.
Sofia L: small compliance: if candidate used different last name on some docs, document the alias in Greenhouse and keep copies of supporting docs. security may want a short note in the file.
Elaine H: accessibility follow-up: looped in DEI (tara@redwood). added captioning to the Day 1 calendar invite. candidate confirmed that works.
Trent R: i'll add myself to the calendar for 9am rep slot and share contact. if marisol chooses notary, please ask for notary receipt so we can reimburse.
Gabe M: update 14:10: marisol booked a notary for Mon 8:30am and uploaded receipt. she also uploaded a bank statement with maiden+current name; forwarded to Checkr.
Sofia L: update 16:00: vendor set CHK-8301 to "review required" then cleared at 18:05 after bank statement. notary-signed Section 2 uploaded. marque in GH set to "onboarded" pending W-4.
ITShipBot: update 19:30: laptop shipped overnight with "Hold for ID" flag. ops will release after Section 2 scan appears in secure folder. tracking #1Z999AA10123456784.
Elaine H: accessibility confirmed: captions will be on and DEI rep will join first 30m. also flagged payroll that benefits enrollment window will be open after Day 1 by HRIS sync.
Gabe M: last check: marisol completed W-4 & DD at 20:10. can we close?
Sofia L: final: Checkr cleared, Section 2 uploaded, notary receipt on file, W-4+DD done, laptop shipped & released after upload, captions enabled. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
